name: wolftrap-security
description: Static review and evidence checks for authorized local repositories using the separately installed WolfTrap CLI.

interface.longDescription: Review authorized local GitHub Actions workflows, Dockerfiles, agent source, prompt documents, and Go permission patterns using a separately installed WolfTrap CLI. The skills explain static signals, check supported saved evidence, and report unsupported or inconclusive inputs. The workflow reads local files and writes evidence to a user-approved directory outside the inspected tree. It does not execute project code. A supported desktop local executor is required.
defaultPrompt: Verify the integrity and limits of this WolfTrap evidence bundle.
